howItWorks.title:
From zero to payout
in three steps.

0.title: Join a campaign
0.body: Browse active brand campaigns, filter by niche and platform, and join with one tap. No pitch needed.

1.title: Create and submit
1.body: Follow the creative brief, publish on your social account, then paste the post URL. Done in under a minute.

2.title: Collect your earnings
2.body: Views are independently verified and your reward lands in your wallet automatically. Withdraw any time.

testimonials.featuredQuote: "I made more from one campaign than I used to earn in a full month. The process is completely transparent."

2.quote: Payments always on time, no chasing.

0.a: Register, browse campaigns, join one that fits your niche, publish your content, then paste the URL. Once verified and approved, earnings land in your wallet automatically.

1.q: What follower count do I need?
1.a: Requirements vary by campaign — some are open from 1,000 followers, premium campaigns may require 20,000+. Each campaign page shows the exact minimum.

2.a: Most campaigns pay CPM — cost per thousand verified views. A SAR 12 CPM campaign pays SAR 12 for every 1,000 views your content earns. Calculations are automatic and fully transparent.

3.q: How quickly do I get paid?
3.a: After your content is approved and the tracking window closes, earnings move to your wallet. Withdrawals to Saudi bank accounts are processed on a regular cycle.

4.a: TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and X. Each campaign specifies which platforms are accepted.

5.q: Is Content Rewards free for creators?
5.a: Yes — free to join, free to participate. The platform earns a small fee from campaign budgets; creators keep the majority of every reward.
